Sources & display limits.

The numerical view uses the saved surface_mesh_smoothed COMSOL export, with a display range of 56,766–326,888 Pa. Nearest exported values are assigned to surface vertices and interpolated within connected triangles. These display limits do not change the original field. The CT appearances come directly from the two repaired colored 3MF packages; numerical stress is not inferred from their colors.

The continuous CT preview displays the largest exterior component, with 35,999 triangles. Original 3MFs retain all 32,687,264 triangles and internal components. Point mode uses 60,000 original field or CT samples. Browser lighting approximates the source materials. Unphotographed fossil colors are illustrative continuations.
